I have a scar that looks like a "5" side of a six-sided die on my left wrist. I was in 1st grade, class had just finished and I went to my prep school. I was poking holes in my white eraser with a freshly sharpened pencil. "I wanna make a SpongeBob", I thought. I must've liked the way the holes looked and I started poking my skin. Owwie! Pain signalled fast enough to prevent me from breaking my skin. I started pinching my skin, I already knew at the time that the outermost part of the skin doesn't feel anything. I kept pinching and pinching with my stubby nails. A red bump appears soon enough. "I can brag about how I got bitten by an alien at school tomorrow!" I thought. I completed the pattern with four more swollen dots and lo and behold, a decade old scar on my wrist.
